Record notes

Plan evidence-led brand, offer, campaigns, search, conversion and measurement with complete first-party and retained licensed methods.

Version 0.3.0 includes 10 complete skill procedures. Full canonical methods and all 245 task routes, including current licensed YouTube Summarizer source; optional official publisher methods require separate installation.

Requirements: Your offer, audience evidence, brand scope and current task constraints; Optional official Codex providers: aihumanizer@openai-curated-remote, uiuxdesigner@openai-curated-remote, creative-production@openai-curated-remote; Optional recipient-owned YouTube transcript server and messaging integration for retained publisher method; no automatic install or send; Optional recipient-owned Atlas Marketing local binding; separate Writing Quality, Research, Social, Graphic/Video, Work Management when installed.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0 AND MIT; per-file first-party and retained upstream scopes in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add marketing-strategy-studio@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP keeps its portable manifest at the root and preserves the referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from d9102ebae7dc6b9d51049fdb6212d0877e9767d1. SHA-256: b3e021569657f45deeebd491f268dc5564e293a5ecd7e1894c9232a46e8cd8ad.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
